content.concept_description: A scroll lists the relaxing features of the arrow puzzle game before demonstrating arrow-clearing gameplay that ends with an error collision.
content.why_it_works: Contrasts calming promised benefits with engaging puzzle-solving gameplay that triggers an urge to intervene when an error occurs.

visuals.notable_objects: ancient parchment scroll, arrow maze, pointer hand

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: A hand cursor taps unblocked arrows in a dense maze to slide them off the screen.

chapterization.chapter_description: Scroll rolls down asking if viewer wants the most relaxing arrow puzzle game
Checklist of game features written out with voiceover narration
Hand cursor systematically untangles arrows from the outer edges of the puzzle
Cursor taps an arrow that hits a wall/obstacle and turns red in a failed move
Clean white end card with the game name Arrows

_evidence.hook_trigger:Curiosity Gap: 00:01 - Text on scroll asks 'Looking for the most relaxing arrow puzzle game?'
_evidence.hook_emotion:Curiosity: 00:01 - Question prompt invites viewer to see what game is being introduced
_evidence.persuasion_triggers:Curiosity Gap: 00:02 - Prompts viewer to discover the arrow puzzle game
_evidence.persuasion_triggers:Challenge / Ego Thre: 00:50 - Tapping a blocked arrow triggers a red failure path
_evidence.ad_emotion:Relaxation: 00:20 - Gentle sliding arrows with soothing music and gentle tapping sounds
_evidence.ad_emotion:Frustration: 00:50 - An arrow collision turns red, interrupting the smooth clearing progress
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Puzzle Solving: 00:25 - Finding which exterior arrows can freely escape the maze
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Satisfying Moment: 00:30 - Multiple arrows smoothly flying off screen in sequence
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Failure: 00:50 - Blocked arrow turns red upon collision with an obstructing line
_evidence.ad_format: Rule 1 applied: board shows direct arrow untangling puzzle mechanics of the advertised game on an unmodified board

_audit.problem: The text shown during the hook ('Looking for the most relaxing arrow puzzle game?') is a question/inquiry rather than a challenge to the viewer.
